claims.text: Sodium polystyrene sulfonate: reduced use (questionable efficacy; GI complications such as colonic necrosis in older adults);
claims.quote: Sodium polystyrene sulfonate, historically a mainstay treatment, has seen reduced use owing to questionable efficacy and potential gastrointestinal complications such as colonic necrosis in older adults.
